title: Notifications
subtitle: Alerts, recommendations and news about your account and your homes.

actions.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.

confirmClear.title: Delete notifications
confirmClear.message_one: {{count}} resolved or read notification will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirmClear.message_other: {{count}} resolved or read notifications will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

dailyExceeded.title: Daily limit exceeded
dailyExceeded.message: The home "{{home}}" went over the configured daily consumption limit.

monthlyApproaching.title: Close to the monthly limit
monthlyApproaching.message: The home "{{home}}" is close to reaching the configured monthly consumption limit.

high.title: High consumption
high.message: A device in "{{home}}" is using more power than usual.

critical.title: Critical consumption
critical.message: A device in "{{home}}" is using power at a critical level.

deviceOffline.title: Device disconnected
deviceOffline.message: A device in "{{home}}" stopped reporting consumption data. Check its WiFi connection.

generic.title: New recommendation
generic.message: There is a new recommendation for "{{home}}".

peakHours.title: Shift usage out of peak hours
peakHours.message: A large share of last week's consumption in "{{home}}" happened between 6 and 10 p.m. Running the washer, iron or oven at another time lowers your bill.

standby.title: Cut standby consumption
standby.message: "{{device}}" in "{{home}}" keeps drawing power overnight. Unplug it or use a switched power strip when you are not using it.

aboveAverage.title: Your consumption is rising
aboveAverage.message: "{{home}}" used considerably more energy this week than the previous one. Check what changed in how your appliances are used.

limitProjection.title: You are on track to exceed your limit
limitProjection.message: At the current pace "{{home}}" will exceed the consumption limit you set. Reduce the use of the appliances that consume the most.

deviceIncrease.title: An appliance uses more than before
deviceIncrease.message: "{{device}}" in "{{home}}" is consuming more than in previous weeks. It may need maintenance or be in use more than usual.

all.title: No notifications
all.description: When the system detects something relevant in your homes, you'll see it here.

alerts.title: No active alerts
alerts.description: There are no pending alerts to review right now.

recommendations.title: No recommendations
recommendations.description: There are no recommendations generated for your homes yet.

activity.title: No activity
activity.description: You'll see here when someone joins your homes, changes their thresholds or links a device.

linked.title: New device linked
linked.message: "{{home}}" has a new device connected and it is already sending measurements.

autoResolveHint.threshold: Resolves itself when consumption is back to normal
autoResolveHint.connectivity: Resolves itself when the device reconnects
autoResolveHint.limit: Resolves itself when a new period starts or if you raise the limit

daily.title: Daily limit reached
daily.message: "{{home}}" has already used today the daily limit you set.

monthly.title: Monthly limit reached
monthly.message: "{{home}}" has already used this month the monthly limit you set.

welcome.title: Welcome to Energy Monitor
welcome.message: Your account is ready. Create a home or join one with its code to start seeing your devices' consumption.

created.title: You created a home
created.message: You created {{home}}. Share its code so others can join, and link your devices.

removed-you.title: You're no longer a member of a home

member-removed.title: A member left the home
member-removed.message: {{subject}} is no longer a member of {{home}}.

ownership-received.title: You're now the owner
ownership-received.message: {{actor}} transferred {{home}} to you. You're now its owner.

deleted-by-you.title: You deleted a home
deleted-by-you.message: You deleted {{home}}. Its devices were unlinked.

deleted.title: A home was deleted
deleted.message: {{actor}} deleted {{home}}. You're no longer a member.
